mapper.sql: c.course_id AS courseId, COALESCE(cc.course_name, ko.course_name, c.name) AS title, COALESCE(cc.description, ko.description, c.description) AS description, c.type AS type, NULLIF(c.thumbnail_url, '') AS thumbnailUrl, c.place_cnt AS placeCnt

LEFT JOIN course_content cc ON cc.course_id = c.course_id AND cc.language = (SELECT m.locale FROM member m WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId}) LEFT JOIN course_content ko ON ko.course_id = c.course_id AND ko.language = 'ko'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM course c
WHERE c.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.course_id DESC

SELECT FROM course c
WHERE c.is_active = TRUE AND c.course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT cp.sort_order AS courseSeqNo, p.place_id AS placeId, p.place_name AS placeName, NULLIF(p.first_image, '') AS image, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.add1, NULLIF(p.add2, '')) AS address, p.map_y AS latitude, p.map_x AS longitude FROM course_place cp JOIN place p ON p.place_id = cp.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE WHERE cp.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cp.sort_order ASC, cp.course_place_id ASC
